data.name: Aanisah
data.gender_notes: Aanisah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-s-h', meaning 'to help' or 'to aid'. Aanisah is a name of compassion, generosity, and kindness. It represents a woman who is always ready to lend a helping hand, and who strives to make the world a better place for all. The name Aanisah carries the meaning “Helpful, beneficent, gracious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aanisah usually hope their child will grow to embody helpful, beneficent, gracious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of grace and kindness, symbolizing the virtues of a noble and compassionate soul.
data.etymology: Aanisah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Helpful, beneficent, gracious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aanisah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
